candidate_finding.title: OAI-SearchBot is disallowed on the pricing page
candidate_finding.evidence: https://example.com/pricing: robots.txt contains 'User-agent: OAI-SearchBot' with 'Disallow: /pricing'; the same path returns 200 to a browser-UA fetch from the auditor's IP.
candidate_finding.why_it_matters: OpenAI documents that sites disallowing OAI-SearchBot 'will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers, though can still appear as navigational links.'

suggested_action.summary: Allow OAI-SearchBot on public decision pages; keep any training-bot (GPTBot) policy unchanged if that restriction is intentional.
suggested_action.acceptance_test: After the change, no robots.txt rule for OAI-SearchBot matches /pricing, and a fetch with that User-Agent returns 200.

candidate_finding.title: robots.txt returned 503 on the single audit attempt
candidate_finding.evidence: https://example.com/robots.txt returned 503 on one attempt during the audit; a single occurrence is inconclusive (severity_model rule 6).

suggested_action.summary: Confirm robots.txt availability over time; a single 5xx may be transient.

not_evaluated.reason: single-locale site; hreflang alternates not applicable
